notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
When FTP uses TLS (FTPS), openssl s_client with -starttls ftp negotiates the upgrade and exposes the full certificate chain. Certificate commonly contains internal hostname and administrator email address — passive intelligence without touching the target's FTP data directly.

=== CHAINING ===
Discover FTPS on port 21 or 990 → openssl s_client → extract cert CN (internal hostname) and email (admin contact) → cross-reference with other findings → use standard FTP client with TLS for actual file operations.

=== CERTIFICATE INTEL ===
Subject CN: internal hostname (may differ from DNS name). Subject Alt Names: additional hostnames. Issuer: internal CA indicates Active Directory Certificate Services. Email: zone admin / system admin contact.
